samples.title: Giờ làm linh hoạt
samples.prompt: Employers should offer flexible hours when the work allows it. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
requirementsVi: Nêu lập trường đồng ý.
Giải thích lợi ích bằng cơ chế và ví dụ.
Bàn tính khả thi, thừa nhận giới hạn và chốt lập trường.
samples.summaryVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that employers should offer flexible hours when the work allows it raises a useful question about flexible working hours. I agree with this view because it can meet a practical need. My support does not mean that every version of the proposal will work; the way it is introduced is also important.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng ý rõ, không khẳng định mọi cách làm đều tốt.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — lợi ích
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that employees can organise work around practical personal needs. This is possible because different starting times can reduce clashes between work and family responsibilities. For example, a parent can start earlier on two days so that they can collect a child from school. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — cách làm khả thi
paragraphs.text: A second reason for supporting this approach is that its difficulties can be addressed through practical changes. A practical response would be to set core hours and make availability clear to the team. For example, a department could agree that everyone is reachable between ten and three while allowing choice outside that period. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lý do thứ hai là có cách xử lý trở ngại cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Giới hạn và kết
paragraphs.text:
It is true that team members may not be available at the same time, especially because a task that needs several people can be delayed if their schedules do not overlap. This calls for better planning rather than the complete rejection of the idea.

In conclusion, I support the view that employers should offer flexible hours when the work allows it. The main benefit is that employees can organise work around practical personal needs. However, careful planning and a response to practical difficulties are needed if that benefit is to be achieved.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận giới hạn và giữ lập trường đồng ý.

samples.title: Lương và sự hài lòng
samples.prompt: People should consider job satisfaction as well as salary. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

samples.summaryVi: Chọn việc cần cân nhắc cả nhu cầu tài chính và trải nghiệm làm việc hằng ngày.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that people should consider job satisfaction as well as salary raises a useful question about choosing a satisfying job. I agree with this view because it can meet a practical need. My support does not mean that every version of the proposal will work; the way it is introduced is also important.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng ý rõ, không khẳng định mọi cách làm đều tốt.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — lợi ích
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that workers can think about the quality of their daily working life. This is possible because interest in the work and supportive colleagues can make a role easier to sustain. For example, a teacher may value a school where colleagues share materials and help new staff solve classroom problems. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chọn việc cần cân nhắc cả nhu cầu tài chính và trải nghiệm làm việc hằng ngày.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — cách làm khả thi
paragraphs.text: A second reason for supporting this approach is that its difficulties can be addressed through practical changes. A practical response would be to compare basic financial needs with working conditions and opportunities to develop. For example, a job seeker could list minimum living costs before comparing two offers with different responsibilities. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lý do thứ hai là có cách xử lý trở ngại cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Giới hạn và kết
paragraphs.text:
It is true that personal interest alone may not cover essential living costs, especially because rent, transport and family expenses still need to be paid regularly. This calls for better planning rather than the complete rejection of the idea.

In conclusion, I support the view that people should consider job satisfaction as well as salary. The main benefit is that workers can think about the quality of their daily working life. However, careful planning and a response to practical difficulties are needed if that benefit is to be achieved.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận giới hạn và giữ lập trường đồng ý.

paragraphs.text: The proposal that colleges should help students find well-supported work placements raises a useful question about work placements for students. paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that workplaces should keep meetings focused and purposeful raises a useful question about team meetings. I agree with this view because it can meet a practical need. This is possible because a clear agenda separates issues that need discussion from information that can be sent in writing. For example, a team can spend fifteen minutes agreeing on a delivery problem instead of listening to an hour of unrelated updates. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Họp có mục đích tiết kiệm thời gian; vẫn phải cho người ít nói cơ hội chuẩn bị và góp ý.

paragraphs.text: A second reason for supporting this approach is that its difficulties can be addressed through practical changes. A practical response would be to share questions in advance and invite contributions from everyone. For example, a manager could send a short agenda the day before and collect written comments after the meeting. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lý do thứ hai là có cách xử lý trở ngại cụ thể.

In conclusion, I support the view that workplaces should keep meetings focused and purposeful. The main benefit is that staff can understand decisions without losing large amounts of working time. However, careful planning and a response to practical difficulties are needed if that benefit is to be achieved.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận giới hạn và giữ lập trường đồng ý.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that businesses should train staff to handle complaints clearly and respectfully raises a useful question about customer service training. I agree with this view because it can meet a practical need. My support does not mean that every version of the proposal will work; the way it is introduced is also important.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng ý rõ, không khẳng định mọi cách làm đều tốt.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — lợi ích
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that customers can understand what can be done about a problem. This is possible because clear communication can turn a confusing situation into a series of practical steps. For example, a shop assistant can explain the return process and tell a customer when to expect a response. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giao tiếp lịch sự cần đi cùng quy trình và quyền xử lý để khách nhận được bước tiếp cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — cách làm khả thi
paragraphs.text: A second reason for supporting this approach is that its difficulties can be addressed through practical changes. A practical response would be to give staff clear guidance and a reliable route for difficult cases. For example, a manager could provide a simple decision guide and make sure complex complaints reach the right person. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lý do thứ hai là có cách xử lý trở ngại cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Giới hạn và kết
paragraphs.text:
It is true that staff may be unable to solve problems without authority, especially because polite language alone does not change an unclear or inflexible company process. This calls for better planning rather than the complete rejection of the idea.

In conclusion, I support the view that businesses should train staff to handle complaints clearly and respectfully. The main benefit is that customers can understand what can be done about a problem. However, careful planning and a response to practical difficulties are needed if that benefit is to be achieved.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận giới hạn và giữ lập trường đồng ý.
